title: fix(core): rename TypeWireContianerOpts to TypeWireContainerOpts
body:
Renames the misspelled `TypeWireContianerOpts` type to `TypeWireContainerOpts` and keeps the old name as a deprecated alias, so existing imports still compile.

The typo is in the public API, so new users copy it from the docs. Removing the alias can wait for the next major version.

**Look at:** the `@deprecated` note on the alias in `packages/core/src/index.ts`.

Tests weren't run locally; CI will run them.
